title: MCPiler Manifest 0.3 server section
description: Routing identity, the mount's authorization posture, and the surfaces. A surface's operation list is the single runtime exposure authority; whether a token is required is decided once for the whole mount.

authenticationRequired.description: Whether this mount is an OAuth 2.1 protected resource. Absent means protected. Declared per mount, never per surface: every surface of a mount answers under one prefix, and a mount that protected one surface while leaving a sibling open would disclose the protected sibling's tool names through a listing. A surface's 'requiredScopes' is meaningful only while this is true.

surfaces.description: Omit entirely to have one default surface synthesised over every declared agent operation.

pageSize.$comment: No upper bound here. 100 is the maximum a Navigator discover call may request, which is a tool input rule, not a manifest rule.

surfaceOperation.description: Membership of this list is the grant. An omitted exposure means 'direct'; 'hidden' must be spelled out.
